content: Non-NixOS GUI: HM targets.genericLinux.enable = true sets XDG_DATA_DIRS etc. on non-NixOS; home.packages installs apps + .desktop in ~/.nix-profile/share/applications. Known issue: GNOME Show Applications may miss nix apps (home-manager#1439); fix via xdg.desktopEntries / XDG_DATA_DIRS. xdg.mimeApps for defaults. FHS-sensitive apps pre-wrapped in nixpkgs (fine); nix-ld needs OS-level /lib linker symlinks - practically NixOS-only, defer on non-NixOS. Prefer packages with HM programs.* modules for desktop integration.
